segments.ja228:1.1: Tayo giriṃ antaraṃ kāmayāmi, pañcālā kuruyo kekake ca [kurayo kekaye ca (sī.)];
segments.ja228:1.3: Tatuttariṃ [taduttariṃ (ka.)] brāhmaṇa kāmayāmi, tikiccha maṃ brāhmaṇa kāmanītaṃ.
segments.ja228:2.1: Kaṇhāhidaṭṭhassa karonti heke, amanussapaviṭṭhassa [amanussavaddhassa (sī. pī.), amanussaviṭṭhassa (syā.)] karonti paṇḍitā;
segments.ja228:2.3: Na kāmanītassa karoti koci, okkantasukkassa hi kā tikicchāti.
